messages.author: 8bf0927cf6c5a784
messages.subject: plot label sizes
parts:
Is it possible to change sample label size for plots generated by clusterSamples() or PCASamples()? If you have long sample names, they get cut off and become unreadable.

On that note, is possible to change any other visual properties for the plots?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] plot label sizes
parts:
unfortunately, it is not possible to change the features of the plots. Although, this is an easy fix we might consider to add it in the future versions. PCASamples and clusterSamples returns objects from the analysis they can be used for replotting with different label sizes

Best,
Altuna
